description: Add an item to a list. The data is checked against the list's schema and its write rules (rule lookups cost 1 request per item they read). Strings in the data can be $jsonpad-var: variables, substituted when the item is saved, e.g. "$jsonpad-var:now", "$jsonpad-var:now(+5m)", "$jsonpad-var:uuid", "$jsonpad-var:random-integer(1, 100)" (see the docs for the rest). Returns the new item's metadata (and data with returnData) and its etag. 1 request.

data.description: The item's data: any JSON value, usually an object

list.description: The list: its id or pathName

returnData.description: Return the item's data after the write (default: metadata only)

tags.description: Tags (at most 20). Replaces the existing tags

version.description: A version label for the item

name: create_item
title: Create an item
